Title: Bounced bleeds and Form of Mist

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
J. Hunter Johnson <jhun...@io.com> wrote:
>The recent ruling on Form of Mist & Bum's Rush (restart the unblocked combat)
>has given me another question: What happens when Raven bleeds Methuselah A,
>Democritus deflects it to Methuselah B, Nik blocks, and Raven uses superior
>Form of Mist as her strike?
>Is the bleed of MethA the original action, and thus the one that gets
>continued? Or is the bounce still in effect?

All modifiers of the action, including the Deflection, will still be in
effect when the bleed action continues. Methuselah B is still the one
being bled.
